notes.title: Demo Updated! Visual Polish, Font Improvements & Bug Fixes 🛠️
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thanks so much for the continued support and feedback you've shared. I’ve just released a new demo update with several key improvements:

✨ What’s New in This Update:
Visual & Animation Improvements
The art and animation have been refined to provide a more consistent and polished experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/92bf2b5d9e62362b949f0b074eb96dba719b0883.gif"]


Font Enhancements for CJK Languages
Fonts for Korean, Chinese (Simplified), and Japanese have been updated for better readability and localization support.

Bug Fixes
Various issues reported by the community have been addressed.

Special thanks to everyone who took the time to share bugs and suggestionsit really helps shape Presidential Rise into something better.


This update brings the demo closer to what I envision for the full release. I’ll continue improving and updating based on your input.

Thanks again for playing the demo,

— Getty ✊

notes.title: Dev Update: Improving Visual Consistency!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/3987fd20392a32731effd4643bbe839f7ba6b792.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/cee4e11c4a4405278040011310da8993d253eb01.gif"]



I’ve received a lot of feedback about the visual art style of Presidential Rise, especially around consistency. As a solo developer using AI-generated art, I know it hasn’t always been perfect and I truly appreciate all your honest feedback.

That said, I’m currently working on new visual updates, including improved animation and more consistent art direction. I’m excited to share more with you soon!

Thanks again for playing and supporting Presidential Rise.

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements - Demo Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for trying our game demo!

We’ve fixed a critical issue that was preventing some players from starting the game. The latest version of the demo is now live and ready to play. We sincerely appreciate your patience and feedback during this process.

Please feel free to try the game again, and we hope you enjoy the improved experience!

Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for your support!


🔧 [Hotfix Update – April 21]
A new fix has just been uploaded to resolve the issue that was still preventing some players from starting a new game.

If you’ve already downloaded the demo and are experiencing issues, please try restarting Steam to get the latest build. If that doesn’t help, a reinstall might do the trick.

Thank you again for your incredible patience. I’m doing my best to address these issues as quickly as possible, and I truly appreciate your support and understanding!
